seo.title: Francorosso
seo.description: A travel agency in Lugano. Tailor-made journeys, escorted group departures, flight ticketing, insurance and corporate events. Via Canova 19.

hero.title: A journey takes shape when you talk to someone who has already been.
hero.lede: We are an agency on Via Canova. We build tailor-made itineraries, escort our own group departures and look after the travel of companies across Ticino. You can start here, or come and see us.

image.brief: Horizontal photograph of the team at work on an itinerary, natural light. Not a posed group shot.

services.title: Four ways to travel with us
services.intro: Every request lands on one named person's desk, not in a queue.

items.title: Tailor-made journeys
items.body: It starts with a conversation: who is travelling, how much time you have, what you do not want to miss. We write the itinerary, you correct it until it looks like you.

items.title: Group departures
items.body: Journeys we organise ourselves, with fixed dates, clear prices and an Italian-speaking tour leader. It is the part of the work we are proudest of.

items.title: Flight ticketing
items.body: Issuing, reissues, changes and negotiated fares. If something goes wrong at the airport, you have a number that answers.

items.title: Business & MICE
items.body: Meetings, conventions, incentives, corporate events and recurring business travel. One contact for logistics, suppliers and budget.

departures.title: The journeys we organise ourselves
departures.intro: Fixed dates, itineraries we have checked, a tour leader who knows the route. We are not reselling a catalogue: we build these journeys and we travel with them.

why.title: The difference is who picks up the phone
why.pullquote: Tell us how you want the journey to feel, and we will shape the details with you.

points.title: A person, not a ticket number
points.body: From the first quote to the flight home you speak to the same consultant. They know your file and how you like to travel.

points.title: Transparent pricing
points.body: We tell you what is included, what is not, and what our work costs. No surprises when the balance falls due.

points.title: Reachable when it matters
points.body: You travel with a direct number. A missed connection is solved faster from the agency than at the desk.

points.title: An office in Lugano
points.body: Via Canova 19. You can walk in, sit down and look at the options together, without an appointment.

image.brief: Detail of the Via Canova 19 shopfront or entrance, portrait format, late afternoon light.

insurance.title: Travel insurance, settled in two minutes
insurance.body: Cancellation, medical expenses, baggage. It is the part of a trip nobody thinks about until it matters. Send us the dates and the value of the journey and we will send back the right policy and a link to pay for it.
bullets: Cover also available for trips booked elsewhere
Confirmed by email, without coming to the office

mice.title: When the whole company travels
mice.body: We organise meetings, conventions, incentives and corporate events, and we run recurring business travel. One contact for flights, hotels, rooms, transfers and reporting.

image.brief: Horizontal format: a meeting room or gala dinner set up, seen from inside the group.

team.title: Six people, one office, no call centre
team.intro: We know who you are because we are the ones who answer. Here is who you are writing to.

contact.title: Tell us about the journey. We will handle the rest.
contact.body: A few lines are enough. We reply within one working day with a first concrete proposal, with no obligation.
